inkwave-3c.desc_en: The full input, movement, action and camera chain, comparing the original with direct following.

inkwave-materials.desc_en: Generated textures, wet coatings, sunlight, HDR bloom and color grading.

inkwave-ui.desc_en: Focus feedback, staggered entrances, ink transitions and skippable results.

inkwave-paint.desc_en: GPU appearance and CPU ownership, adapted into toxic zones or speed-boosting ground.

inkwave-combat.desc_en: Decoupled trajectories, hits, particles, camera, sound and events.

inkwave-ai.desc_en: Original territory bots and a rescue strategy share navigation and movement.

inkwave-world.desc_en: Geometry, collision, surfaces and navigation share one source; seeded props are batched.

inkwave-audio.desc_en: Synthesized effects, spatial audio, layered music and voice management.

inkwave-diagnostics.desc_en: Fixed timesteps, pause and single-step, load adjustment and resource cleanup.

feel-cam.desc_en: Run and jump a fox among slopes, steps and boxes; press C to switch between follow and free cameras.

feel.name_en: Physics character with fixed follow camera
feel.desc_en: A fox movement scene with only a follow camera, for tuning character parameters.

drive.desc_en: Driving built into the same character library: wheels, suspension and grip, with WASD controls.

drone.name_en: Flying a drone with ecctrl propellers
drone.desc_en: A thrust-driven drone that balances itself; Space to rise and WASD to move.

planet.name_en: Planet and wall walking with ecctrl custom gravity
planet.desc_en: The fox can walk around a small planet and up walls as the gravity direction changes in real time.

cloudkeep-cam.desc_en: The smooth follow camera from your game: drag to rotate without jumps, press C to recenter, and follow softly.

tank-cam.desc_en: The camera pulls in at walls, raises its view uphill and zooms in wheel-controlled steps, inspired by tank games.

retarget.desc_en: Apply one character’s animation to another with different proportions, for purchased or generated animations.

crowd.desc_en: Two hundred animated foxes appear together, drawn in GPU batches without stuttering.

look.desc_en: A realistic sky, sun shadows and grass material, without post-processing.

look-post.desc_en: Adds ambient occlusion, bloom and color grading to the base scene.

look-presets.desc_en: Original, cinematic, bright, evening and overcast: click a name to switch lighting and color grading.

lut.desc_en: Switch between warm, cool, teal-orange, bleach bypass and black-and-white looks, with adjustable strength.

motion-blur.desc_en: Trails when the fox runs or the camera turns add a sense of speed.

ssgi.desc_en: Light bounces between walls; a red wall tints nearby surfaces red for greater realism.

sky.desc_en: Realistic sky colors and sun; move time from dawn to dusk and watch the lighting change.

volume-cloud.desc_en: Three-dimensional clouds with adjustable density and edges.

fog.desc_en: Ground-hugging fog thickens with distance: clear higher up and denser near the ground.

rain.desc_en: Tens of thousands of raindrops computed on the GPU in real time, splashing on the ground.

lightning.desc_en: Lightning strikes every few seconds, cracking the ground, scattering sparks and shaking the view; click to strike.

atmosphere.name_en: Atmosphere and volumetric clouds for large worlds
atmosphere.desc_en: Realistic atmospheric scattering and cloud layers make distant mountains and houses naturally blue and hazy, for large open worlds.

trees.desc_en: More than ten types of procedurally generated trees; leaves sway in the wind (branches stay still), with less detail at a distance.

plants.desc_en: Twenty tree and plant species generated by species rules, with wind effects, already running on WebGPU.

destruct.desc_en: Click walls or ground to dig holes and blast craters, changing geometry in real time.

ocean.desc_en: An open ocean with rolling waves reflecting the sky and sun.

pool.desc_en: A pool of flowing water that reflects and refracts surrounding objects.

shallow.desc_en: The fox walks in shallow water, with the ground and its legs visible below the surface.

quarks.desc_en: A campfire, click-to-explode ground and a magic vortex, all built from particles in code.

flames.desc_en: Stylized flames drawn entirely with TSL node materials, without texture sequences.

volume-fire.desc_en: Flames with volume that look three-dimensional from every angle.

cloth.desc_en: GPU-simulated cloth that blows in the wind and collides with a ball.

birds.desc_en: Thousands of birds flock above the ground, all computed on the GPU in real time.

npc.name_en: NPC behavior: wandering, fleeing and chasing
npc.desc_en: Twelve small characters: green ones wander, blue ones avoid the fox, and red ones chase it.

navcrowd.desc_en: Thirty people navigate a town; click the ground and they walk there around houses and each other.

ropes.name_en: Ropes and hinges: bridge, chains and lamps
ropes.desc_en: A suspension bridge, chains and lamps joined by physics joints sway when the fox bumps into them.
